title: Derived symmetry of component module pullback
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Lambda and w-contractible affine T [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model], assume continuity, braidedness, and finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation of the component inverse image. For every coefficient ring-object isomorphism alpha from its image of Lambda on pi_0(T) to Lambda_T, the fixed componentDerived functor admits a strong braided structure for the ordinary Koszul derived braidings.

proof.text: Let G be the fixed component inverse image and F its module lift followed by coefficient transport. The sheaf pullback adjunction lifts to modules, and restriction along the coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence, so F is an additive exact left adjoint. Use Mod.ResidueOrdinary.mapModComapMonoidal to construct its strong monoidal structure from the balanced coequalizers.

Prove the ordinary braiding equation by precomposing with the epimorphic balanced tensor projection. The explicit tensorComparison_inv_π equation reduces it to the braided equation for G and the tensorObjπ_braidingHomX equation. Cancel the tensor projection. Cancel the invertible tensorator to obtain the corresponding equation for the oplax tensor comparison. This is the proved private helper mapModComap_braiding and the calculation hδ in the Lean proof.

Ordinary component module pullback preserves flat objects by [lem-zl-component-pullback-flat]. Apply the proved source-library construction Functor.leftDerivedFunctorBraided from WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.LeftDerivedFunctor.MonoidalStructure to F and the oplax braiding equation. That construction uses K-flat replacements and the signed total-complex comparison, and supplies a strong braided left derived functor for the fixed native DerivedCategory.braidedCategory' braidings. Exactness gives leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. Transport the monoidal structure along that natural isomorphism; Functor.Monoidal.natTransIsMonoidal_of_transport and Functor.LaxBraided.ofNatIso give the braided structure on the fixed termwise componentDerived functor.

proof_origin.place: J9, 2026-10-25: Construction (4.1), Proposition 4.3(3), Remark 3.2. Explicit balanced tensor braiding calculation, followed by the proved source-library leftDerivedFunctorBraided construction and monoidal transport to mapDerivedCategory. Ordinary flatness is isolated as lem-zl-component-pullback-flat.
